Review: Vibe Model on R4P NNLC Gen 2
||* Everything is compared to TR7 which has precise and confident lat. TR7 feels like it is locked onto a rail in lane center.
* Vibe feels a lot like Vikander. Not terrible. Vibe and Vikander are able to consistently stay in lane on my Toyota. TR10 can't stay in lane.
* But lat is noticeably less precise than TR7. It works pretty well but it feels less confident. It is meandering a bit between lane center and right line. Not terrible. TR7 is just more predictable.
* Low speed lat feels weaker than TR7.
* I didn't test much long. It utterly failed to recognize highway slowing into a red light. I had to slam on the brakes. It handled someone merging in front of me into a slowdown pretty well (but that might have also been `tn` Dec so I don't know for sure).||
Either Vikander and TR10 or TR7 and TR10

One of the better models I've used in general from a comfort perspective, hugs left for me, and it did decide to exit the left lane an use the shoulder on I-5 once, a bit spooky. Just a trip from Seattle to Portland to test so far.
